description: This PHP source file defines the class RelativeStream in the Laminas\Diactoros namespace. The class implements the StreamInterface and acts as a wrapper around another StreamInterface instance to represent a subpart starting from a specific offset, aiming to optimize memory usage when handling parts of streams.

classes.name: RelativeStream
classes.description: Final class implementing StreamInterface, representing a subpart of another stream starting at a specified offset.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decorated stream and the offset from which to create the subpart.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the stream, seeking to the start if necessary.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying decorated stream and returns it.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the subpart, adjusted for the offset.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the subpart, relative to its start.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates whether the underlying stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the stream, adjusting for the offset if whence is SEEK_SET.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, throwing an exception if the pointer is invalid.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, throwing an exception if the pointer is invalid.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Gets the remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata information of the stream.
